description: TRON account state read straight off our own node: TRX balance, whether the account is activated, energy and bandwidth (used / limit), whether it is a witness, and account age. When to use: TRX balance and resource state before sizing a transfer, or checking whether an address exists on chain. Do not use: for USDT/TRC-20 token balances (use tron_read_contract with balanceOf) or for address risk scoring (that is tron_check_address_risk). Returns: found, address, trx_balance, name, created_ms, last_operation_ms, is_witness, has_code, energy, bandwidth.
name: tron_get_account
